note: Catalogue of every shuttle and fighter type, for pre-game use: fleet building, force
legality by year, and pickers. The live objects are Java classes in com.sfb.objects.shuttles;
this file is what the game consults BEFORE a shuttle exists.
type      the key used by a ship's shuttleBays list and by the ShuttleBay factory
kind      fighter = bought with BPV, added to the carrier's cost
shuttle = carried at no cost
Suicide shuttles, scatter-packs and wild weasels are deliberately NOT here. They are roles
an admin shuttle takes on, not types anyone buys or stocks; CoiLoadout prices those
conversions in Commander's Option points at setup.
factions  which factions may field it; ["any"] = all of them
year      first year of service; 0 = always available
bpv       purchase cost; absent for anything not bought with BPV
BPV here must match what the Java class constructs — ShuttleCatalogTest pins the two.
canWeasel        J3.18 — any non-fighter shuttle may be charged as a Wild Weasel;
fighters never may (J4.41).
canSuicide       J2.222 — admin, minesweeping, MRS, SWAC and minelaying shuttles may
be armed as suicide shuttles; fighters, HTS and GAS may not.
scatterPackSize  FD7.11 — rack spaces of drones it may carry as a scatter pack;
0 = not a qualified shuttle. Only admin, MRS, MLS, MSS and FIGHTERS
qualify, so this list is NOT the same as canWeasel: a GAS may weasel
but not scatter-pack, and a fighter is the other way round. That is
why both are data rather than one "special shuttle" flag.
UNVERIFIED: the SIZE for each type. Six spaces is what the old
hardcoded ScatterPack allowed and is applied across the board here;
FD7.44 governs fighters as SPs and has not been read.
